description: This file manages secret target identifiers for different command contexts within the OpenClaw project. It includes functions to retrieve, filter, and normalize secret target IDs related to channels, models, agent runtime, status, security audits, and remote QR codes, with support for scoped channel and account-specific access.

methods.name: idsByPrefix
methods.description: Filters secret target registry entries by specified prefixes.

methods.name: idsByPredicate
methods.description: Filters secret target registry entries by a predicate function.

methods.name: buildCommandSecretTargets
methods.description: Constructs the CommandSecretTargets object with various secret ID lists.

methods.name: getCommandSecretTargets
methods.description: Returns cached or newly built command secret targets.

methods.name: toTargetIdSet
methods.description: Converts an array of strings to a Set of strings.

methods.name: normalizeScopedChannelId
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a channel ID string.

methods.name: selectChannelTargetIds
methods.description: Selects target IDs for a given channel, or all if none specified.

methods.name: pathTargetsScopedChannelAccount
methods.description: Checks if a path segment array matches a specific channel and account ID.

methods.name: getScopedChannelsCommandSecretTargets
methods.description: Retrieves secret target IDs and allowed paths for a scoped channel and account.

methods.name: getQrRemoteCommandSecretTargetIds
methods.description: Returns secret target IDs for QR remote commands.

methods.name: getChannelsCommandSecretTargetIds
methods.description: Returns secret target IDs for channel commands.

methods.name: getModelsCommandSecretTargetIds
methods.description: Returns secret target IDs for model commands.

methods.name: getAgentRuntimeCommandSecretTargetIds
methods.description: Returns secret target IDs for agent runtime commands.

methods.name: getStatusCommandSecretTargetIds
methods.description: Returns secret target IDs for status commands.

methods.name: getSecurityAuditCommandSecretTargetIds
methods.description: Returns secret target IDs for security audit commands.
